purpose: M5 packed-install and cross-model explicit global-memory dogfood

fixture.isolation: Separate disposable Pi agent directories, nested Git projects, and XDG data homes; every prompt used a fresh no-session agent turn.
fixture.globalMemory: Status updates should lead with the outcome and stay concise.
fixture.projectMemory: Status updates must include a detailed diagnostic appendix.
fixture.defaultModes: guarded in both independently selected corpora

runs.finding: The model guessed unsupported routes: `both remember` wrote one Memory to each corpus, `global ingest` fell back to a project ingest job, and mixed recall silently returned project memory only.

With all cross-scope grammar removed from the Pi prompt, the portable skill preflight remained normative but the model again rerouted unsupported `global ingest` into project ingestion. This established that a narrow pre-activation Pi guard was still necessary for this client/model combination.

runs.source: final local working tree with narrow Pi pre-activation guard

runs.finding: The provider returned finish_reason error during global remember; no product conclusion was drawn.

remediation.summary: Put exact global/both grammar validation at the start of the portable skill and ahead of all tools; retain only the same proven pre-activation guard in the thin Pi adapter; require one fixed rejection for unsupported cross-scope routes; and prevent mixed recall from degrading to one corpus.

conclusion: Pass after remediation. The smaller-model failure was reproduced, hardened, and rechecked with no corpus or job mutation. The Gemini provider attempt remains explicitly inconclusive.
